deploy.v93_root_cause: FOUND + FIXED. v92 proved (a) device IS on the new bundle (visible 'build v92' tag rendered on Profile) and (b) the Orders tab crashed natively even when its screen was a zero-dependency View+Text placeholder. That isolated the fault to the OrdersStack mount, NOT the screen content — which is why all 4 prior screen-content fixes failed. Root cause: OrdersStack registered a Stack.Screen name='OrderDetail' explicitly AND again via SHARED_SCREENS(Stack) (which already includes OrderDetail) → DUPLICATE route name in a createNativeStackNavigator. react-native-screens corrupts its native container on a duplicate name and hard-crashes (uncatchable by the JS ErrorBoundary) the instant the stack mounts = the instant the Orders tab is tapped. ProfileStack works because it lists screens manually and never spreads SHARED_SCREENS, so it has no duplicate. Fix: removed the explicit OrderDetail line from OrdersStack (SHARED_SCREENS provides it); restored the real OrderHistoryScreen as OrdersHome. Audited all stacks — OrdersStack was the only duplicate. Build tag bumped to v93 to confirm freshness this round.
deploy.v92_note: v91 stripped Orders STILL crashed natively on-device. Stripped Orders uses only primitives the working Profile screen renders safely, so either the device is not on v91 (stale bundle) or the crash is the tab/native-stack mount itself. v92 disambiguates: (1) hardcoded 'build v92' tag on the working Profile screen — seeing it proves the device is on v92; (2) Orders tab initial screen swapped to a zero-dependency View+Text placeholder. Profile=v92 AND placeholder crashes -> native tab-mount fault. Placeholder renders -> crash was inside OrderHistoryScreen render. Profile not v92 -> OTA bundle-delivery problem.
